components.name: AuroraBackground
components.description: Velora's signature animated aurora backdrop. Absolutely positioned — place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` section.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall opacity of the aurora blobs

components.name: BackgroundBeams
components.description: Decorative light beams flowing along curved paths — a full-section background. Place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of beams

components.name: BackgroundBoxes
components.description: An isometric grid of cells that light up in random brand tints under the pointer and fade slowly back. Absolutely positioned — place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` section. Content above it blocks the pointer, so give text wrappers `pointer-events-none` to keep the grid reactive.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of rows (capped at 40)

props.name: cols
props.description: Number of columns (capped at 40)

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Cell edge length in px, before the isometric tilt

props.name: fade
props.description: How long a lit cell takes to fade back, in ms

components.name: DottedGlowBackground
components.description: A canvas dot grid with soft glows drifting across it; dots near a glow brighten, grow and tint toward `--brand`. Unlit dots use the inherited text colour. Absolutely positioned — place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` element.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between dot centres in px

props.name: radius
props.description: Dot radius in px (lit dots grow up to 1.6×)

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of unlit dots, 0–1

props.name: speed
props.description: Glow travel speed multiplier

props.name: glows
props.description: Number of travelling glows

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause while the pointer is over the parent element (focus inside it always pauses)

components.name: FlickeringGrid
components.description: Grid of squares that fade in and out on staggered timers. Rendered as a plain DOM grid with CSS animation delays — no canvas, no dependency.

props.name: squareSize
props.description: Square size in px

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between squares in px

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns and rows to render

props.name: squares
props.description: Cells to fill, as [col, row] pairs

components.name: Lamp
components.description: A glowing lamp-line header. The light cone expands as it scrolls into view; children render beneath the glow.

components.name: LightRays
components.description: God rays fanning down from the top of a section. Pure CSS gradients on skewed elements — nothing paints per frame.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of rays fanning out from the origin

props.name: spread
props.description: Total spread of the fan, in degrees

components.name: Meteors
components.description: Falling meteor streaks. Values are derived from the index (not random) so server and client markup always match.

components.name: NoiseBackground
components.description: A soft brand-gradient wash — three blurred blobs drifting slowly — under a static film-grain overlay. Wraps its children, which sit above both layers.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film-grain opacity, 0–1 (0 hides the grain)

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause the drift while hovered (focus inside always pauses it)

components.name: Particles
components.description: Drifting, twinkling particle field on a lightweight canvas. Renders a single static frame when reduced motion is preferred.

props.name: color
props.description: "r, g, b" string. Defaults to the inherited text color, so it adapts to the theme.

components.name: RetroGrid
components.description: Scrolling perspective grid backdrop. Place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` section.

props.name: angle
props.description: Perspective angle of the grid plane

components.name: Ripple
components.description: Concentric rings pulsing outward from the centre — a calm backdrop for "connected" or "listening" states.

props.name: circles
props.description: Number of concentric rings

props.name: baseSize
props.description: Diameter of the innermost ring, in px

components.name: StarsBackground
components.description: A still field of stars that gently twinkle. Stars take the inherited text colour (set `text-white` on a dark section); one in five is brand-tinted. Absolutely positioned — stack `ShootingStars` on top for the full sky.

props.name: density
props.description: Stars per 10,000 px²

components.name: ShootingStars
components.description: Occasional brand-tinted streaks crossing the section at a random angle, speed and delay. Absolutely positioned — layer over `StarsBackground`. Under reduced motion a single streak is shown frozen mid-flight.

props.name: delay
props.description: Average pause between streaks in ms; each pause varies ±60%

props.name: speed
props.description: Travel speed in px per second; each streak varies ±30%

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction in degrees below horizontal; each streak varies ±12°

props.name: length
props.description: Trail length in px

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour or custom property name

components.name: Vortex
components.description: A field of brand-tinted particles spiralling into the centre, leaving fading trails. Absolutely positioned — place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` section. Trails glow additively when the inherited text colour is light (i.e. on a dark section).

props.name: particles
props.description: Maximum particle count; capped by container area so small screens draw fewer

props.name: speed
props.description: Rotation speed multiplier

props.name: range
props.description: How far the swirl reaches towards the edges, 0–1

components.name: WavyBackground
components.description: Layered, blurred ribbons of colour flowing sideways on a canvas. Absolutely positioned — place inside a `relative overflow-hidden` section and layer content above it. Defaults to the brand ramp and follows theme changes; ribbons blend additively when the inherited text colour is light.

props.name: waves
props.description: Number of layered waves

props.name: speed
props.description: How quickly the waves drift

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius in px applied to the wave layer

props.name: colors
props.description: Any CSS colours or custom property names (e.g. "--brand-from"); cycled across the waves

props.name: opacity
props.description: Opacity of each wave, 0–1

components.name: FlipWords
components.description: Cycles through words with a blur-flip transition.

props.name: duration
props.description: ms each word stays on screen

components.name: HyperText
components.description: Scrambles through random letters and resolves into the real text, one character at a time. Renders the final text on the server.

props.name: frame
props.description: Milliseconds between scramble frames

props.name: onHover
props.description: Scramble on hover instead of on mount

components.name: MorphingText
components.description: Blurs one phrase out while the next resolves in, so the two appear to melt through each other. Pure CSS filters — no runtime dependency.

props.name: hold
props.description: Seconds each phrase is held at full clarity

props.name: morph
props.description: Seconds spent blurring between phrases

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait after entering the viewport

components.name: SparklesText
components.description: Text with twinkling stars around it. Positions are derived from the index so server and client markup match.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of sparkles

components.name: TextHighlighter
components.description: Marker-pen sweep that draws behind the text when it scrolls into view. Useful for the one phrase in a paragraph that has to land.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour; defaults to a translucent brand wash

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the sweep

components.name: TextHoverEffect
components.description: Oversized outlined text that draws itself in, then reveals a brand-gradient version of the word inside a soft spotlight that follows the pointer. Size it with a width class (`w-full`); the height follows the text. Weight and font come from the className, e.g. `font-black`.

props.name: text
props.description: The word or short phrase to draw

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Outline width in SVG units (the glyphs are 100 units tall)

props.name: revealRadius
props.description: Radius of the pointer reveal, as a percentage of the drawing's size

props.name: drawDuration
props.description: Seconds the outline takes to draw itself in on mount

props.name: text
props.description: Plain text — revealed word by word

props.name: stagger
props.description: Seconds between each word

components.name: TextShimmer
components.description: A soft light sweep across the text — great for "AI thinking" states and subtle emphasis.

props.name: typeSpeed
props.description: ms per typed character

props.name: deleteSpeed
props.description: ms per deleted character

props.name: holdTime
props.description: ms to hold a completed word

components.name: WordRotate
components.description: Swaps a single word on a vertical roll. Lighter than Flip Words — no blur, no spring — for headlines that need the effect to stay quiet.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds each word is held

components.name: MagneticButton
components.description: Button that leans toward the cursor while it is nearby and springs back when the pointer leaves.

props.name: strength
props.description: How far the button is allowed to travel toward the cursor, in px

components.name: MovingBorder
components.description: Button with a light that laps its border, driven by `offset-path`. Zero dependencies — one keyframe does the whole thing.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one lap of the border

props.name: size
props.description: Length of the travelling light, in px

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the border path, in px

components.name: RainbowButton
components.description: CTA with a colour ramp that cycles through the brand gradient and casts a matching glow beneath it. Zero dependencies — the motion is one keyframe.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for one full colour cycle

components.name: RippleButton
components.description: Button that expands a ripple from the exact point you pressed. Ripples are skipped entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds for a ripple to finish expanding

props.name: rippleColor
props.description: Any CSS colour; defaults to a translucent version of the text colour

components.name: StatefulButton
components.description: A button for async actions. When `onClick` returns a Promise the button shrinks to a spinner, then shows a check (or a cross if it rejects) and returns to idle after `resetAfter` ms. Its layout width never changes. Recolour it with `[--surface:var(--color-brand)]`; style states with `data-[state=success]:` and friends.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler; return a Promise to show loading, then success or error

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds the success or error state stays before returning to idle

props.name: successText
props.description: Shown beside the check and announced when the promise resolves

props.name: errorText
props.description: Shown beside the cross and announced when the promise rejects

components.name: ThemeToggler
components.description: Light/dark switch that wipes the new theme in as an expanding circle from the button itself, using the View Transitions API where it exists and falling back to a plain toggle everywhere else.

props.name: isDark
props.description: Current theme; drives the icon and the accessible label

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Apply the theme change. Called inside a View Transition when supported.

components.name: AnimatedList
components.description: Reveals children one by one, newest on top, then loops. Wrap in a fixed-height container with a bottom mask for a feed effect. The loop pauses while hovered or focused; under reduced motion all items are shown at once.

props.name: delay
props.description: ms between items appearing

components.name: AnimatedTooltip
components.description: Avatar row with springy name tooltips on hover and keyboard focus.

types.name: TooltipItem

props.name: people
props.description: Names rendered as initials

props.name: extra
props.description: "+N" badge count

props.name: background
props.description: Visual filling the card behind the text (chart, image, animation…)

components.name: HoverCards
components.description: Grid of link cards with a soft brand highlight that glides to whichever card is hovered or focused. Columns respond to the container's width, not the viewport's, so it fits sidebars and full-width sections alike.

props.name: items
props.description: The link cards, in order

props.name: columns
props.description: Column count once the container is wide enough (container queries)

types.name: HoverCardItem

components.name: CardStack
components.description: Deck of cards that shuffles the top card to the back. Good for rotating quotes or tips in a fixed-height slot.

props.name: items
props.description: Each entry becomes one card; the first is on top

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds between automatic shuffles; 0 disables

props.name: offset
props.description: Vertical offset per card, in px

components.name: CompareSlider
components.description: Before/after wipe with a draggable divider. The handle is a real range input, so it works with arrow keys and screen readers for free.

props.name: initial
props.description: Starting divider position, 0–100

props.name: label
props.description: Announced by the slider handle

components.name: DirectionAwareHover
components.description: Overlay that enters from the edge the cursor actually crossed and leaves the same way. Zero dependencies — the maths is one arctangent.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Slides in from whichever edge the cursor crossed

props.name: baseSize
props.description: Icon size at rest, px

props.name: magnification
props.description: Icon size under the cursor, px

props.name: distance
props.description: Cursor influence radius, px

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; also used as the tooltip title

props.name: href
props.description: Render as a link to this URL instead of a button

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler for the button (or link)

components.name: DraggableCardContainer
components.description: The board that scatters its `DraggableCard`s and keeps them inside its bounds. Give it a height (default h-96).

props.name: children
props.description: `DraggableCard` elements

components.name: DraggableCard
components.description: A photo-style card for `DraggableCardContainer`: drag or fling it (it tilts with the motion and springs back inside the board), nudge it with arrow keys, and press Enter or Space to bring it to the front.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the card, e.g. its caption

props.name: rotate
props.description: Resting tilt in degrees (defaults to a seeded ±7° per card)

components.name: EvervaultCard
components.description: Card that reveals a field of random, brand-tinted characters through a soft circular mask that follows the pointer; the characters reshuffle as it moves. Keyboard focus inside the card reveals the mask at the centre. `label` renders a centred badge; `children` render below it.

props.name: label
props.description: Centred badge content (text or an icon) drawn above the character field

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the reveal mask in px

props.name: interval
props.description: Minimum ms between re-randomising the characters while the pointer moves

components.name: ExpandableCard
components.description: Card that expands into a centred panel, with the title and media animating between the two positions via a shared layout id.

props.name: children
props.description: Shown only once the card is expanded

props.name: media
props.description: Rendered in both the collapsed card and the expanded panel

components.name: FileTree
components.description: Collapsible file tree for documenting project structure. Renders as nested lists, so it stays readable with CSS off.

types.name: FileNode

components.name: FocusCards
components.description: Image grid where the card you point at (or tab to) stays sharp while the rest soften and step back, and its title rises over a gradient. Pure CSS — no client JavaScript. Cards with an `href` are links; the others are focusable figures so keyboard users can reveal their titles too.

props.name: cards
props.description: The cards, in order

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Extra classes for every card, e.g. a different aspect ratio

types.name: FocusCard

components.name: GlareCard
components.description: Card with a sheet of light that tracks the cursor across its surface, like a foil trading card. CSS custom properties do the work — no dependency.

components.name: LayoutGrid
components.description: Bento grid of image tiles. Clicking a tile morphs it into a panel that fills the grid, with the other tiles dimmed behind it; Escape, Close or a click outside collapses it and returns focus to the tile. The root is the grid: set columns and row height with className (default 3 × 11rem).

props.name: items
props.description: Tiles, in reading order

types.name: LayoutGridItem

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverse the scroll direction

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause the animation while hovered (it always pauses while focus is inside)

props.name: vertical
props.description: Scroll vertically instead of horizontally

props.name: repeat
props.description: Number of content copies (keep >=2 for a seamless loop)

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the edges with a mask

components.name: OrbitingCircles
components.description: Evenly distributes children around a circular orbit and rotates them. Place inside a `relative` container; stack multiple instances with different radii for multi-ring layouts.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds per revolution

props.name: radius
props.description: Orbit radius in px

props.name: path
props.description: Show the orbit ring

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Diameter of each orbiting item in px

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the spotlight in px

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS color for the glow

components.name: TiltCard
components.description: 3D perspective tilt that follows the cursor.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Maximum tilt in degrees

components.name: WobbleCard
components.description: A large coloured card that drifts a few pixels toward the pointer while its content drifts a little further, then springs back on leave. Colour it with `className` (defaults to the brand colour); keyboard focus inside gives it a gentle lift.

props.name: strength
props.description: Furthest the card shifts toward the pointer, in px

props.name: depth
props.description: How much further the content moves than the card (parallax), as a multiple

props.name: grain
props.description: Show the film-grain texture

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner content wrapper (padding lives here)

components.name: Sidebar

props.name: defaultPinned

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Called when the pin toggle is pressed

components.name: SidebarBody
components.description: The rail on wide containers, the top bar and drawer on narrow ones.

props.name: logo
props.description: Icon-sized mark, always visible

props.name: title
props.description: Product name next to the logo; fades in with the labels

props.name: footer
props.description: Links pinned to the bottom (e.g. settings or the account)

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark

props.name: pinnable
props.description: Show the "Keep expanded" toggle at the bottom of the rail

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the navigation panel (rail and drawer)

props.name: children
props.description: SidebarLink elements

components.name: SidebarLink

props.name: icon

props.name: label

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page (sets aria-current="page")

components.name: AnimatedTabs
components.description: Tabs with a pill that glides to the selected tab and panels stacked like cards: the next panels peek out behind the active one, scaled and offset. Follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with automatic activation.

props.name: tabs

props.name: value

props.name: peek

components.name: FloatingNavbar

props.name: revealAfter

props.name: scrollContainer
props.description: Scrollable element to watch instead of the window

components.name: NavbarMenu

props.description: Renders the item as a link; ignored when the item has a panel

props.name: items
props.description: Links shown in the bar (and in the mobile menu)

props.name: logo
props.description: Brand mark or logo link on the left

props.name: cta
props.description: Call to action on the right (e.g. a sign-up link)

props.name: threshold

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark

props.name: container

types.name: NavItem

components.name: StickyBanner

components.name: FileDrop

props.description: Passed straight to the underlying input

components.name: Stepper

props.name: onStepClick
props.description: Make completed steps clickable; other markers render as plain text

components.name: VanishInput

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the input

components.name: OrbitLoader

props.name: time

components.name: HeroParallax

Heights use `cqh`, so inside a `@container-size` scroll box they measure that box instead of the viewport. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the block stays flat and the rows wrap so every card is visible.

props.name: products
props.description: Cards, split evenly across three rows

props.name: children
props.description: Hero copy shown above the rows

props.name: drift
props.description: How far each row slides sideways over the scroll, in px

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Extra classes for every card, e.g. to resize them

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to track instead of the window

types.name: HeroParallaxProduct

components.name: MacbookScroll
components.description: A laptop drawn in CSS that pins in place, opens its lid and scales the screenshot to fill the screen as you scroll. Heights use `cqh`, so inside a `@container-size` scroll box they measure that box instead of the viewport. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the laptop renders open and still.

props.name: src
props.description: Screenshot shown on the screen

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for `src`; leave empty if the image is decorative

props.name: children
props.description: Custom screen content, used instead of `src`; `cqw` units scale with the screen

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the laptop, rendered in an h2

props.name: badge
props.description: Small element on the lower-left of the deck, e.g. a logo

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to track instead of the window

components.name: ParallaxGrid
components.description: Image or card grid whose columns drift at different rates as the page scrolls, giving a gallery a sense of depth. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` a CSS override pins every tile in place.

props.name: children
props.description: Each child becomes one tile; columns drift at different speeds

props.name: depth
props.description: Maximum vertical drift in px

props.name: container
props.description: Track this scroll box instead of the window

components.name: ScrollVelocity
components.description: A marquee whose speed and direction respond to how fast you are scrolling. Holds a steady drift when the page is still, pauses while hovered or focused, and stays still under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

props.name: baseVelocity
props.description: Base speed in percent of content width per second

components.name: StickyScroll
components.description: Long-form copy that scrolls past a pinned panel; the panel swaps as each section takes over. The classic "how it works" section. Heights use `cqh`, which resolves against the viewport unless an ancestor is a size container (e.g. a fixed-height scroll box with `@container-size`).

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to track instead of the window

types.name: StickyScrollItem

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Vertical timeline: each entry's label sticks beside its content while a gradient beam fills the track as you scroll. Sticky offsets use `cqh`, so inside a `@container-size` scroll box they measure that box instead of the viewport. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the beam is drawn in full.

props.name: items
props.description: Entries, rendered in order as an ordered list

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to track instead of the window

types.name: TimelineItem

components.name: TracingBeam
components.description: A gradient line that draws itself down the side of long-form content as you read. Pairs well with blog posts and changelogs.

components.name: AnimatedBeam
components.description: Animated gradient beam connecting two elements inside a shared `relative` container. Pass refs to the container and both endpoints.

props.name: curvature
props.description: Vertical bend of the beam in px (positive bends up)

components.name: BlurFade
components.description: Fades and un-blurs its children in as they scroll into view. Content starts invisible until JavaScript runs, so don't wrap your page's largest above-the-fold element (usually the hero headline or intro): it delays Largest Contentful Paint. Fade the badges, buttons and visuals around it instead.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the animation starts

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the element enters from

props.name: offset
props.description: Distance travelled in px

props.name: once
props.description: Animate only the first time it enters the viewport

props.name: inView
props.description: Start animating immediately instead of waiting to scroll into view

components.name: BorderBeam
components.description: Animated beam that travels around the border of its nearest positioned ancestor. Parent needs `position: relative` and a border.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the beam in px

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds of delay before starting

components.name: GlowingEffect
components.description: A glowing arc on a card's border that turns to face the pointer and fades in as the pointer comes within `proximity` px. Place it as a direct child of a `relative` card; it inherits the card's border radius. Keyboard focus inside the card lights the whole border.

props.name: proximity
props.description: Distance in px outside the card at which the glow starts to fade in

props.name: spread
props.description: Length of the lit arc, in degrees of the border

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Thickness of the glowing border in px

props.name: halo
props.description: Add a soft blurred halo behind the lit border

components.name: Card3D
components.description: Perspective card that rotates toward the pointer. Wrap parts of its content in `Card3DItem` with a `depth` (px) and they lift off the surface at different heights while the pointer is over the card. Keyboard focus inside the card lifts the items to a gentle resting depth without tilting.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Maximum rotation toward the pointer, in degrees

props.name: perspective
props.description: CSS perspective distance in px (smaller = stronger 3D)

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Classes for the rotating surface (avoid overflow-hidden: it flattens the layers)

props.name: children
props.description: Card content; wrap layers that should lift in Card3DItem

components.name: Card3DItem
components.description: A layer inside `Card3D` that floats `depth` px above the card surface.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the item lifts toward the viewer, in px (translateZ)

props.name: rotateX
props.description: Extra rotation around the X axis at full lift, in degrees

props.name: rotateY
props.description: Extra rotation around the Y axis at full lift, in degrees

props.name: rotateZ
props.description: Extra rotation around the Z axis at full lift, in degrees

components.name: Pin3D
components.description: Card that tilts back in perspective on hover or keyboard focus while a glowing pin rises from its centre, topped by a `title` chip, with rings rippling out across the card at the pin's base. Pass `href` to make the whole card a link. Leave room above the card for the pin (about 1.5rem).

props.name: title
props.description: Label shown in the chip at the top of the pin

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card a link; without it the root is a plain div

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Classes for the card surface that holds the children

props.name: children
props.description: Card content, drawn on the tilting surface

components.name: Marquee3D
components.description: A grid of images tilted in 3D whose columns scroll endlessly, alternating up and down. Give it a height (default h-112) and place copy on top. Scrolling pauses offscreen and on hover; under reduced motion the tilted grid rests in place.

props.name: images
props.description: Image URLs, or { src, alt } objects (images without alt are decorative)

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns on the tilted plane

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop of a column

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the edges into the background

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause scrolling while hovered

props.name: imageClassName
props.description: Extra classes for every image tile

types.name: Marquee3DImage
types.source: type Marquee3DImage = string | { src: string; alt?: string };

components.description: Snap-scrolling row of `CarouselCard`s with previous/next buttons.

props.description: Accessible name for the scrollable region

components.name: CarouselCard

components.name: ImageSlider
components.description: Full-bleed crossfading image slider with autoplay, dots, arrows, arrow keys and swipe; children are layered above the images. Autoplay pauses on hover/focus and offscreen, and never starts itself under reduced motion.

props.name: images

components.name: FollowingPointer
components.description: Wrap a region to swap the system cursor for a coloured arrow and name tag, like a collaborator's cursor, that trail the pointer on a spring. It only takes over for a mouse on a fine-pointer device; touch keeps the defaults, and the overlay never blocks clicks.

props.name: label
props.description: Content of the name tag next to the arrow; leave empty for an arrow only

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the arrow and tag

components.name: Lens
components.description: A circular magnifier that follows the pointer over an image (or any content). Keyboard users can focus it, move the lens with the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps) and hide it with Escape. The magnified copy is aria-hidden and inert.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to magnify, usually an `` that fills the box

props.name: zoomFactor
props.description: How many times the lens magnifies

props.name: radius
props.description: Lens radius in px

props.name: staticPosition
props.description: Pin the lens open at this spot (percentages of width and height) and ignore the pointer — handy for touch screens and product callouts

components.name: PointerHighlight
components.description: Frames an inline phrase when it scrolls into view: an outline draws out from the top-left corner, then a small pointer glides in to rest on its bottom-right corner, like a selection someone just made. The phrase becomes an inline-block, so keep it short enough not to wrap.

components.name: SmoothCursor
components.description: A page-level custom cursor: a dot that sits on the pointer and a ring that trails it on a spring and grows over links, buttons and form controls. props.name: ringClassName

components.name: Globe
components.description: Dotted 2D-canvas globe with markers and animated great-circle arcs. Drag (with inertia) or use the arrow keys to rotate; auto-rotation pauses while hovered or focused. Give it a width — height follows (it is square).
